title: Short HTTP 200 responses are misclassified as a fast public link
test: tests/relayCapacityProbe.test.js · an empty 200 body is reported as failed, not as a fast link; a small 200 body is reported as failed, not as a fast link
proof: On the unchanged code both short-body tests fail: expected failed, actual fast. The existing test of a download over before the ramp-up used a 10,000,000-byte body, below PROBE_BYTES (10,485,760), so it pinned the defect; the reviewer gave it a full PROBE_BYTES body (10 x 1,048,576), which keeps its intent: a whole probe delivered before the ramp-up is fast.
